price_convention: Raw unadjusted open/close plus separate split and cash-dividend events. Never add dividends to an already total-return-adjusted series.
calendar: Every declared session/asset requires an explicit row, including suspension and post-delisting rows.
decision: Features available through signal close. First fill attempt on the next declared session open, after corporate actions.

events.split_factor: Integer forward splits only; reverse/fractional actions fail pending cash-in-lieu implementation
events.dividend: Per post-split share, ex-date entitlement before trades
events.dividend_pay_date: Accrue nominal receivable on ex date; cash only on pay date
events.delist_cash: Per held share terminal cash recovery; position closes before trading

label: 21-session mark-to-open total economic return after next-session entry; includes dividend entitlements and terminal recovery. Not a promise of executable exit liquidity.
unexecutable_label_entry: Label status NO_EXECUTABLE_ENTRY and null target. Track attrition; do not silently coerce to zero.
unmatured_label: Null target; excluded from fit until label window closes before signal minus embargo.
execution: Whole shares, sells before buys, explicit fees/slippage, cash and volume caps. Unfilled orders expire, no automatic later fill.
capacity: Session-volume participation is a coarse fixture capacity check, not evidence of fillable opening-auction liquidity.
currency: USD accounting unit in fictional fixture; no real exchange or holiday calendar is represented
